title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p19p: dead code and double computation in FragmentSender::new
description:
## Issues in fragment.rs

### 1. Unused `body_bytes` in `Ack::write_to`
`fragment.rs:285` — `body_bytes` is computed but never used:
```rust
let body_bytes = n.div_ceil(8);  // unused
```
This was refactored from old code that used it to zero-initialize body bytes, but now `out[..needed].fill(0)` handles that.

### 2. Unused locals `mic` and `count` in `FragmentSender::new`
`fragment.rs:459-460` — both computed but shadowed by struct field initializers:
```rust
let mic = compute_mic(payload);           // computed, unused
let count = payload.len().div_ceil(TILE_SIZE);  // computed, unused
Ok(FragmentSender {
    ...
    count: payload.len().div_ceil(TILE_SIZE),  // recomputed
    mic: compute_mic(payload),                 // recomputed
})
```
This causes `compute_mic` to be called twice and `div_ceil` twice.

### Recommended fix
Remove local variables and use struct field initializers directly, or use locals in struct fields.
